LENGTH-VS-ROUTE CONTRADICTION, 30x -- VERDICT: the route geometry is very likely wrong; the sheet's 18.45 km LengthKnown is very likely right. EVIDENCE: (1) The Jiangxi DRC gas utilisation plan (same citable PDF as shared_evidence.md's DRC-plan URL, https://img9.qianzhan.com/policy/202307/14/20230714-d7d735aa6fb9eae9.pdf, different section -- 表5 省级天然气管道规划建设项目 'Table 5, provincial gas pipeline planned/under-construction projects', internal page marker -16-, in 三.1 省级天然气管道) lists 72 planned Phase-I-branch and Phase-II projects (per the table's own intro: '规划建设的省级天然气管道主要包括：省天然气管网一期工程支线项目和省天然气管网二期工程...共计72段管道，长约2260公里' -- i.e. this table is specifically Phase-I BRANCH-line projects, matching this row's own 'Fengxin Branch' naming). One entry, transcribed verbatim from the OCR text: '石鼻阀室一奉新            16     安义靖安门站             20. 5' -- read as 石鼻阀室-奉新 (Shibi Valve Station to Fengxin), 16 km [the row is a two-column table; the right-hand entry 安义靖安门站/20.5 is a different, unrelated project]. (2) Geographic plausibility: the sheet's own StartPrefecture/District='Anyi County' places this branch's start in Anyi, and Shibi (石鼻) is a town in Anyi County -- consistent with, though not verbatim proof of, Chigang being within or adjacent to that same corridor (Chigang-village-within-Shibi-town was surfaced by web search in the prior session but no citable URL for that specific fact was preserved/re-verified this session, so it is NOT cited as a ref -- background reasoning only). (3) Both the sheet's 18.45 km and Table 5's 16 km describe a short intra-Jiangxi hop between adjacent counties (Anyi and Fengxin border each other), consistent with a named 'Branch' (支线); 553.78 km is roughly two-thirds of the ENTIRE Phase I network's as-built total (870 km per the DRC plan, or 825.00 km per the GEM parent row P4777 in batch_01) -- structurally implausible for one county-to-county branch, and is the run's single worst length-vs-geometry contradiction per the task brief. VERIFICATION: url_verifier's automated substring screen FAILs on this 8.16MB/24-page CJK-text PDF for Chinese-language substrings (re-confirmed this session: FAIL on '石鼻阀室', OK on a bare numeral '870' -- the documented large-PDF/CJK-extraction false-negative family, same as shared_evidence.json and batch_01). Table 5 content spans jx_plan.txt lines ~672-730; the specific quoted line is at line 677. CAVEATS (why this is tier presumed/low, not high): the OCR is severely corrupted throughout Table 5 (adjacent rows show garbling like '宣丰一铜鼓→彦水', '芦田一鄙阳' with a clearly wrong '鄙阳' for 鄱阳, and stray characters like '，、' -- this table is the worst-OCR-quality passage found in the document); '石鼻阀室' (Shibi Valve Station) is not a verbatim match for 'Chigang' (赤岗), only a plausible same-corridor reading; and 16 km (2013-vintage plan) vs 18.45 km (GEM's built figure) is an ~11% gap, consistent with normal planned-vs-built drift, not an exact match.
